source: Kraus et al. (2020), Science 369, 1233, Figure 1A, as printed in the paper's accepted manuscript (ESO release eso2014, science paper eso2014a.pdf, page 20). The figure is a raster: 256 colors read up the middle of its color bar supply the colors, and its nine printed flux ticks calibrate a power transfer through zero, fitted on six ticks and checked on the withheld 0.6 and 0.2 mJy/beam ticks. The recovered bar runs from 0 to 0.839 mJy/beam with display power 0.285; the printed ticks are reproduced to 0.4 microJy/beam. 1024 entries sample equal flux intervals. This is a false-color brightness display for millimeter emission, not visible color.
